transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… work, mostly. I keep forgetting callbacks and work orders, and follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s gotten pretty backed up, and they sent me here before it costs me a chance to move up.
Before age 12, did you often have trouble paying attention or keeping track of things?

Yeah… I think so. I remember it being like that back in grade school, before work was ever a thing. Teachers would say I was bright, but I’d lose papers, miss parts of directions, and need reminders to finish my classwork.
Do these problems with forgetting and losing track of things also happen outside of work, like at home or in daily life?

Yeah… I mean, mostly it’s been showing up at work. Forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s piled up pretty bad. That’s why they sent me here, before I mess up my chance at moving up.
Outside of work, do you also have trouble keeping track of things in everyday life?
Mostly it’s the work stuff I notice… callbacks, work orders, follow-ups I told people I’d handle. It’s gotten piled up enough that they sent me here before I mess up my chance at moving up.
Do you often get distracted in the middle of tasks, even when you want to stay focused?

Yeah. I’ll start a digital work order thinking I’m following it, and then halfway through the notes… my attention just goes somewhere else, like a noise or the next job. Then I look back and realize I don’t really know what I just read.
At home, do you also often forget everyday tasks or lose track of things?
I mean… the main thing is still work. I keep forgetting callbacks, work orders, little follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s gotten bad enough they sent me here, before I lose my chance at moving up.
In your home life, do these attention and forgetting problems also cause problems?
I don’t really know. I haven’t paid as much attention to it at home… it’s mostly been the work stuff people are on me about.
Do you often miss or forget important things at home, like bills, appointments, or chores?

I’m not really sure about bills or appointments at home. The big thing that brought me in is work — I keep forgetting scheduled callbacks, work orders, basic follow-ups I told people I’d do. It’s piled up enough that they sent me here before I mess up my chance at moving up.
Do you also have trouble staying organized in your home life?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t really think about it that way at home. Maybe some things get messy, but… I couldn’t say it’s a big issue.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to deal with?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I spend a lot of time worrying for no reason. I mean, I get concerned when something’s actually going on, but just sitting around worrying, not really.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
I don’t think so. I mean, I have bad days like anyone, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been depressed most days.
Have these attention or forgetting problems ever caused you significant trouble in another part of your life besides work?
I’m not really sure. I mean… outside of work, I can’t think of anything major. Maybe little things here and there, but nothing I’d call significant trouble.
Have your attention or forgetting problems ever caused trouble in school?
Yeah… I guess so. I remember being like that even back in grade school. Teachers would say I was bright, but I’d lose papers, miss parts of the directions, and need reminders to finish my classwork.
When you’re having a conversation with someone, do you often find your mind drifting and miss parts of what they said?

Yeah… that does happen. Like if my supervisor is explaining a repair or an audit thing, I’ll be looking right at him, but only the first part really sticks. Then I end up having to ask him to repeat it.
Do these same attention problems cause problems in your relationships?
I don’t really know. I mean, I’m sure people get annoyed with me sometimes, but I can’t say it’s caused big relationship problems.
